The cheapest five-star book in the Mystery category is **The Girl You Lost**, at **£12.29**.

The category has 32 books across two pages, and I checked every one. Six are rated five stars:

| Title | Price |
|---|---|
| The Girl You Lost | £12.29 |
| The Silkworm (Cormoran Strike #2) | £23.05 |
| What Happened on Beale Street (Secrets of the South Mysteries #2) | £25.37 |
| A Time of Torment (Charlie Parker #14) | £48.35 |
| The Bachelor Girl's Guide to Murder (Herringford and Watts Mysteries #1) | £52.30 |

I opened the category in my own tab (t1) and left it open on page 2, the last page, which is where The Girl You Lost is listed. Partway through, the browser's active tab switched to another agent's page, so I switched back to t1 before reading the data and did not touch the other agents' tabs.

EOF

I submitted the pizza order, and httpbin accepted it. The response page (`https://httpbin.org/post`) is still open in the tab I opened, t2.

The server echoed back these fields:
- **Customer name:** Ada Lovelace
- **Telephone:** 555-0100
- **Email:** ada@example.com
- **Size:** large
- **Toppings:** bacon and extra cheese (submitted as `bacon` and `cheese`)
- **Delivery time:** 19:45
- **Delivery instructions:** "Ring twice"

The session's first tab was on another site and the active tab kept switching to other agents' tabs. I switched back to t2 before each step and didn't touch their tabs.

The order is complete. The final page says "Thank you for your order! Your order has been dispatched, and will arrive just as fast as the pony can get there!"

I logged in as standard_user and sorted by price from low to high. I added the Sauce Labs Backpack and the Sauce Labs Bike Light, and checked out as Ada Lovelace with postal code 10001.

The first tab the browser gave me had been taken over by another agent, so I opened my own tab (t3) and worked only there. It is still open on https://www.saucedemo.com/checkout-complete.html.
